deep_analysis:
Market flipped: the 5m regime scan now shows 110/126 coins LONG_BIAS (was overwhelmingly short-biased hours ago). BTC reclaimed EMA300 (AT after 21.6h below), 15m LONG_BIAS, LEAN_BULL linregs, RECOVERY phase — but the 4h regime is still SHORT_BIAS, so this is a recovery bounce inside a larger downtrend, not a confirmed trend change. Volatility and volume are both LOW: this bounce has not been confirmed by participation.

Our one open trade — ALT SHORT (id 16260, +5.5%) — is on the right side and working. It was a pump-fade (pump-chain-v6) entered at 0.009246; ALT has bled to ~0.00874 and the trailing stop sits at 0.00884, already locking ~4.4% of profit. Thesis intact while price stays below the trail; the broad bounce is the only threat, and the trail exits with profit if ALT reverses. No action needed — let the trail work.

The real story is the 72h meta_rsi matrix: the ONLY profitable cell is LONG at RSI 60-70 (+0.74 USDT, 5/11). Every mean-reversion cell bleeds — mid-band longs (RSI 45-60) won just 28.6% (n=21, -1.41), mid-band shorts won 11% (n=9, -0.64), oversold longs (RSI<35) won 1/4 (-0.28). We make money by joining momentum and lose it by fading or bottom-fishing. The 14/20 losing streak is almost entirely doji-bottom-long falling knives (5-loss streak: ZEN@29.5, WCT@27.8, CRV, YGG, SUSHI — every one a long into a declining tape; the winning side on all five was the SHORT), pump-chain- fade shorts (0/8, -0.49 — fading pumps while the market bounces), and mid-band ai-trader longs that fill after RSI drift (APT picked at 57, filled at 33.7, hard_max_loss — longed the knife).
regime_context: BTC: 81290 vs EMA300 81386 — AT the line after 21.6h below (cross attempt in progress). 15m LONG_BIAS / 4h SHORT_BIAS / continuum AT / trend_quality UP / RECOVERY phase. 5m aggregate: 110 LONG_BIAS, 1 SHORT_BIAS (GMX), 15 neutral — a broad, high-confidence short-term bounce (top confidence: ZORA/BABY/USELESS/NXPC all 95). Velocity SLOW, volume LOW, zscore NEUTRAL: the bounce is structural but unconfirmed by volume. Implication: momentum LONGs on high-confidence 5m leaders are aligned on both timeframes; SHORTS are fighting the short-term tide (except individual pump-fades like ALT that are dumping on their own flow). Do not add oversold mean-reversion longs or mid-band shorts into this bounce. 4h still bearish means keep sizes small and respect the trail — this can fail back into the downtrend at any time.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED (PostgreSQL, 72h, meta_rsi from _signal_metadata, n=54 tagged closes):
1. LONG @ RSI 60-70: n=11, 5W, +0.74 total — THE only profitable cell. Momentum longs work. Winning side: buyers in control, we join them.
2. LONG @ RSI 45-60: n=21, 6W (28.6%), -1.41 — worst cell by absolute loss. Mid-band longs are chop entries; winning side was the fade/short, and we kept longing.
3. SHORT @ RSI 45-60: n=9, 1W (11%), -0.64. Mid-band shorts in a bouncing tape are the wrong side — pump-chain- went 0/8 (-0.49). Winning side: momentum LONG (pump-chain+ made +0.56 over the same window).
4. LONG @ RSI <35: n=4, 1W, -0.28 — oversold longs = catching falling knives (ZEN@29.5, WCT@27.8, APT@33.7 all hard losses). Winning side: SHORT continuation until structure breaks.
5. Signal bleeders 72h: doji-bottom-long -0.51 (n=11), pump-chain- -0.49 (n=8, 0 wins), ai-trader+ -0.46 (n=10), bb-bounce-v2-long+ -0.36 (n=7). All are mean-reversion families. pump-chain+ (momentum) +0.56 is the one family making money.
Root cause of the streak: signals keep firing mean-reversion entries (bottom-fish longs, fade shorts) while the tape's only edge is momentum. We were on the wrong side of every one of those trades — the winning side existed and was visible (momentum longs on RSI 60-70, or shorts only on true pump-fades with locked structure like ALT).
